history.summary: A 624 sqft 99-yr-leasehold 2BR (built 2016) at $875k / $1,402 PSF in D23, 560m from Phoenix LRT. Low and accessible quantum on the value frontier with a reliable 123-txn URA base, but a compact 2BR served only by LRT (not heavy rail) and 3.55%/yr appreciation that just tracks the OCR baseline.
history.rating_rationale: Reliable data (123 txns) shows 3.55%/yr — fair but only OCR-baseline, not outperformance. The $875k quantum gives the broadest, most liquid buyer pool in the batch and PSF is near the $1,389 median. But access is via Phoenix LRT (a feeder line, one interchange to the NSL at Bukit Panjang) rather than direct MRT, which caps the transit premium, and a 624 sqft 2BR is on the compact side. Solidly average — frontier on price efficiency, not catalysts.

history.summary: A 570 sqft 1BR at $1,403 psf in a 416-unit Bukit Panjang (D23/OCR) condo; asking is a small premium to the project's recent average and the location lacks heavy-rail MRT, leaving it a market-typical hold.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,403 psf is a touch ABOVE the verified last-12-month average (~$1,366 psf; range $1,303-$1,426), so the dossier's -11.2% age_adj_premium overstates cheapness - the +2.7% cohort premium on 13 txns is the more honest read (roughly fair, marginally rich). OCR is the best forward region (~+4.0%), which keeps this from an Avoid. But the negatives are structural: Phoenix Road / Bukit Panjang is served by the Bukit Panjang LRT (light rail), not a heavy-rail line at the doorstep, capping rental and resale pull; the 23-block 416-unit project is described as generic; and a 570 sqft 1BR at $800K in CCK/Bukit Panjang competes against ample shoebox supply. Past 3.55% CAGR (123 txns, data-robust) is story only with ~0 forward power. No dated catalyst. A fair-priced unit in an unremarkable OCR pocket = Neutral.

Generic 416-unit project with abundant competing shoebox supply
catalysts: OCR forward-return tailwind (~+4.0% per v3.4 backtest)
Sub-$1M quantum keeps the unit accessible to first-timers/investors
